profile_text.body:
Amplify describes itself as a K-12 curriculum and assessment company that partners with teachers to make learning rigorous and riveting for every student. Its site points to the Amplify CKLA core curriculum, mCLASS assessment and intervention, and Boost Reading personalized learning programs as its answer to aligning a classroom to the Science of Reading, and says these programs help schools build a Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) and a literacy instructional model.

The company's tracked AI product is Amplify mCLASS, listed under education and research AI. It uses automatic scoring and, per the record, no speech recognition. It is used for DIBELS 8 early literacy screening by teachers and students in grades K to 6 under a school license. Pricing recorded from a California filing is $9 per student for one year or $7 multi-year, with a Lectura add-on at $5 and a DIBELS Data System alternative at $1 per student plus $200 setup. A signed Texas student data privacy agreement (TX-NDPA) with Midway ISD, dated 2025, is noted in the SDPC registry.
